rules: a record counts when the planner calls it valid (timed_campaign_plan.cell_states, timing_validity.classify_single_thread: validated, wall-clock budget, one thread on one core of the slots, cpu_share >= 0.9); a cell enters with all its runs valid
a 300-s record carries the configuration, the code hash and the start caches (warm_cache, seed_from) of the 600-s record of the same start, seed and cell

request clock of p124: a run started from the rule schedule at run time t - o_rule, a run started from the policy's schedule at run time t - max(o_pol, o_rule) (p94.read_cells), the greedy schedule from o_pol on, the sampled schedules the policy record's best so far; read at 300 s
best of the runs: per cell the shortest incumbent of the runs of one set at the same time (p124.best_of); each side of a comparison takes the seeds of its own set

difference: 100 (first - second) / second per cell, negative = the first-named method is shorter; mean and 95% interval by p94.compare_at (instance-level cluster bootstrap over base instances, fresh default_rng(7) per quantity); direction from the unrounded interval

verdicts of smp_vs_m300 and smp_vs_mp300 per combination: ahead: the instance-level 95% interval lies below zero and the Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p for "the policy is shorter" (draws of that interval) is below alpha; behind: the interval lies above zero and the Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p for "the policy is longer" (its own Holm family) is below alpha; not distinguishable otherwise. No seed-level test exists for one run. (here the first-named method is the policy's sampled schedules)

decision table: the 300-s values take the places of the two memetic columns (rule only: the column started from the rule schedule alone); each 300-s value a mean over the cells of every other value of its row; lowest column by p94.lowest over the printed values of the six columns, a tie counting in each tied column

p124's smp_vs_best at 300 s, the two memetic columns of its decision table at 300 s, the bold columns of its twelve rows and its count of rows whose lowest column uses the policy: recomputed here and equal to its record, or the script refuses
statistics: p94.compare_at (p94.stat_instance: stats_family.instance_boot, fresh default_rng(7) per quantity; stats_family.direction), p94.mark_held, p94.verdict_at (p94.verdict_family: instance_boot draws, stats_family.boot_p_one_sided, stats_family.holm, p94.selected_verdict), p94.lowest

comparisons.m300_vs_m600: the best of the 300-s runs minus the best of the 600-s runs, both started from the rule schedule, both at 300 s
comparisons.one300_vs_one600: the 300-s run of seed 1 minus the 600-s run of seed 1, both started from the rule schedule
comparisons.smp_vs_m300: the policy's sampled schedules minus the best of the 300-s runs started from the rule schedule
comparisons.pol_vs_m300: the policy's greedy schedule minus the best of the 300-s runs started from the rule schedule
comparisons.cp_vs_m300: CP-SAT (8 workers) started from the rule schedule minus the best of the 300-s runs started from the rule schedule
comparisons.m300_vs_pol: the best of the 300-s runs started from the rule schedule minus the policy's greedy schedule, in percent of the greedy schedule (the form of the decision table)
comparisons.mp300_vs_mp600: the best of the 300-s runs minus the best of the 600-s runs, both started from the policy's schedule, both at 300 s
comparisons.smp_vs_mp300: the policy's sampled schedules minus the best of the 300-s runs started from the policy's schedule
comparisons.mp300_vs_m300: the best of the 300-s runs started from the policy's schedule minus the best of the 300-s runs started from the rule schedule
comparisons.mp300_vs_pol: the best of the 300-s runs started from the policy's schedule minus the policy's greedy schedule, in percent of the greedy schedule (the form of the decision table)

p124_comparison: p124's smp_vs_best: the policy's sampled schedules minus the best of the eight 600-s runs started from the rule schedule (p124.analyse on the same records, equal to p124's record)
